author: monjanse
name: ParticleFur3D
shortDescription: GPU-skinned 3D fur with world-gravity-aligned tail resting hang, stable tail jump/fall inertia, an embedded GDevelop behavior icon, regional masks, texture colors, undercoat and long-coat motion.
description: Version 1.8.9 corrects tail fur that rested diagonally when the tail pointed downward. Tail resting, jump and fall motion now use live world gravity rather than a diagonal surface-tangent projection.
The Particle Fur 3D logo is embedded directly into the extension and behavior icon fields, so it appears in GDevelop's behavior list.

eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Generates GPU-skinned outer coat and undercoat with world-gravity-aligned tail resting hang, stable tail jump/fall inertia, model-verified regional masks, texture colors, rear-head coverage and surface protection.
eventsBasedBehaviors.name: ParticleFur3D

propertyDescriptors.label: 3D capability
propertyDescriptors.description: Connects the extension to the model object's built-in 3D behavior. Leave this set to Object3D.
propertyDescriptors.name: Object3D

propertyDescriptors.label: Enable particle fur
propertyDescriptors.description: Automatically creates and updates the fur at runtime.
propertyDescriptors.name: Enabled

propertyDescriptors.label: Child mesh name
propertyDescriptors.description: Leave empty to use every compatible mesh in the model. Enter an exact child-mesh name to restrict fur generation.
propertyDescriptors.name: MeshName

propertyDescriptors.label: Fur coverage vertex group(s)
propertyDescriptors.description: Restricts where fur may be generated. Separate multiple group names with commas, semicolons, or |. Supports exported attributes and bone names.
propertyDescriptors.name: VertexGroupName

propertyDescriptors.label: Vertex weight threshold
propertyDescriptors.description: Each generated root must have an interpolated coverage-group weight equal to or greater than this value.
propertyDescriptors.name: GroupThreshold

propertyDescriptors.label: Invert fur coverage mask
propertyDescriptors.description: Generates fur outside the selected coverage group instead of inside it.
propertyDescriptors.name: InvertVertexGroup

propertyDescriptors.label: Coverage weight affects length
propertyDescriptors.description: Lower coverage-group weights produce shorter outer-coat hairs.
propertyDescriptors.name: WeightAffectsLength

propertyDescriptors.label: Use whole mesh if coverage group is missing
propertyDescriptors.description: Not recommended. When enabled, a missing coverage group falls back to the whole mesh instead of generating no fur.
propertyDescriptors.name: UseWholeMeshIfGroupMissing

propertyDescriptors.label: Automatically correct inward surface normals
propertyDescriptors.description: Detects meshes whose exported normals point toward the mesh center and reverses the fur direction for those meshes. This fixes fur that grows through a custom model and appears only underneath it.
propertyDescriptors.name: AutoCorrectInwardNormals

propertyDescriptors.label: Manually invert surface normals
propertyDescriptors.description: Manually reverses the generated hair direction after automatic normal detection. Use this when an open or unusual mesh is classified incorrectly.
propertyDescriptors.name: InvertSurfaceNormals

propertyDescriptors.label: Correct every hair root outward
propertyDescriptors.description: Checks the exact source triangle of every generated root. Locally inverted or mixed vertex normals are aligned with the outward-facing triangle direction instead of relying only on one normal direction for the entire mesh.
propertyDescriptors.name: PerRootOutwardCorrection

propertyDescriptors.label: Trust imported vertex normals on concave models
propertyDescriptors.description: Uses valid glTF vertex normals and triangle winding instead of flipping every root away from the whole mesh center. This is important for paws, toes, the rear of the head, armpits, and other concave animal-model surfaces.
propertyDescriptors.name: TrustImportedNormals

propertyDescriptors.label: Minimum root/face normal agreement
propertyDescriptors.description: Minimum dot-product agreement between the interpolated vertex normal and the corrected triangle face normal. Higher values force unreliable custom normals closer to the local surface direction.
propertyDescriptors.name: MinimumFaceNormalAgreement

propertyDescriptors.label: Prevent fur from moving through the surface
propertyDescriptors.description: Projects gravity, wind, and movement so their inward-facing components are removed. Fur may move along or away from the surface, but dynamic motion cannot push it into the model.
propertyDescriptors.name: PreventSurfacePenetration

propertyDescriptors.label: Surface safety outward lift
propertyDescriptors.description: Adds a small outward offset to hanging strands after skinning. This helps long tangential coat remain visibly outside the model. The value is relative to the strand length.
propertyDescriptors.name: SurfaceSafetyLift

propertyDescriptors.label: Regional and length masks extend fur coverage
propertyDescriptors.description: Allows explicit tail, leg, paw, ear, head, long-coat, and regional hair-length masks to add fur where the main Fur coverage vertex group has zero weight or is missing. Automatically detected bone regions may also add coverage.
propertyDescriptors.name: RegionalMasksExtendCoverage

propertyDescriptors.label: Strict vertex-group attribute matching
propertyDescriptors.description: Only accepts attribute-name variants derived from the requested vertex-group name. A missing head, tail, paw, ear, or length mask will never silently fall back to a generic fur attribute.
propertyDescriptors.name: StrictVertexGroupMatching

propertyDescriptors.label: Expand head and paw masks into neighboring vertices
propertyDescriptors.description: Expands explicit head, head-length, and paw masks across connected vertices to cover the back of the head, neck transition, feet, toes, and hooves.
propertyDescriptors.name: ExpandRegionalMasks

propertyDescriptors.label: Regional mask expansion rings
propertyDescriptors.description: Number of connected edge rings used for mask expansion.
propertyDescriptors.name: RegionalMaskExpansionRings

propertyDescriptors.label: Regional mask expansion falloff
propertyDescriptors.description: Weight retained through each mask-expansion ring.
propertyDescriptors.name: RegionalMaskExpansionFalloff

propertyDescriptors.label: Bridge regional masks across nearby disconnected seams
propertyDescriptors.description: Copies head, head-length, paw, and top/back mask weights to nearby vertices even when the GLB contains duplicated seam vertices or separate but touching mesh islands.
propertyDescriptors.name: BridgeRegionalMaskSeams

propertyDescriptors.label: Regional seam bridge radius
propertyDescriptors.description: Maximum bridge distance as a fraction of the mesh's largest native dimension. Start with 0.018. Increase only when a visible seam remains at the back of the head or around a paw.
propertyDescriptors.name: RegionalSeamBridgeRadius

propertyDescriptors.label: Regional seam bridge falloff
propertyDescriptors.description: Weight retained when a regional mask crosses a nearby disconnected seam.
propertyDescriptors.name: RegionalSeamBridgeFalloff

propertyDescriptors.label: Scale hair dimensions to the model's native size
propertyDescriptors.description: Interprets length, thickness, root spread, and surface offset relative to each source mesh's largest local bounding-box dimension. This keeps fur visible on models exported in meters, centimeters, or large custom local units.
propertyDescriptors.name: ScaleHairToModelSize

propertyDescriptors.label: Model-relative hair size multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Multiplies the automatically measured model-relative hair scale. Use values below 1 for shorter/thinner fur and values above 1 for larger fur without changing every individual dimension setting.
propertyDescriptors.name: ModelRelativeSizeMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Maximum automatic hair scale
propertyDescriptors.description: Safety cap for automatic model-relative scaling. Lower this if a mesh contains stray vertices or an unusually large bounding box.
propertyDescriptors.name: MaximumAutomaticHairScale

propertyDescriptors.label: Generated root count
propertyDescriptors.description: Number of distribution roots sampled on the model. Each root may create several outer-coat and undercoat strands.
propertyDescriptors.name: StrandCount

propertyDescriptors.label: Outer strands per root
propertyDescriptors.description: Number of long outer-coat strands generated around each distribution root.
propertyDescriptors.name: OuterStrandsPerRoot

propertyDescriptors.label: Outer-coat length
propertyDescriptors.description: Base outer-coat length in the model's local 3D units.
propertyDescriptors.name: FurLength

propertyDescriptors.label: Outer-coat thickness
propertyDescriptors.description: Base width at the root of each outer-coat ribbon.
propertyDescriptors.name: FurThickness

propertyDescriptors.label: Outer-coat bend segments
propertyDescriptors.description: Number of segments along each outer-coat strand. More segments produce smoother hanging and wave deformation.
propertyDescriptors.name: OuterBendSegments

propertyDescriptors.label: Outer-coat root stiffness
propertyDescriptors.description: Higher values keep more of the strand near the root rigid and move most bending toward the tip.
propertyDescriptors.name: OuterRootStiffness

propertyDescriptors.label: Outer-coat root spread
propertyDescriptors.description: Spreads strands from the same root over the surface. The runtime limits this relative to strand length to prevent visible separation from the model.
propertyDescriptors.name: OuterRootSpread

propertyDescriptors.label: Outer-coat base coverage width
propertyDescriptors.description: Widens the lower part of outer-coat ribbons so neighboring strands overlap and hide the skin.
propertyDescriptors.name: OuterCoverageWidthMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Outer-coat coverage length
propertyDescriptors.description: Fraction of the strand over which the additional base width fades back to normal.
propertyDescriptors.name: OuterCoverageLength

propertyDescriptors.label: Outer-coat coverage planes
propertyDescriptors.description: Number of crossed indexed ribbon planes per outer-coat strand. Two planes provide good coverage with moderate memory use.
propertyDescriptors.name: OuterCoveragePlanes

propertyDescriptors.label: Surface offset
propertyDescriptors.description: Moves every hair root slightly outward from the model surface.
propertyDescriptors.name: SurfaceOffset

propertyDescriptors.label: Auto-detect tail, legs, paws, and ears
propertyDescriptors.description: Uses bone names and skin weights to identify thin body regions automatically.
propertyDescriptors.name: AutoRegionBoneDetection

propertyDescriptors.label: Automatically map common exported fur groups
propertyDescriptors.description: Recognizes BODY, HEAD, FEET, PAWS, EARS, TAIL, and LONGFUR attributes. FEET is mapped to legs while PAWS is mapped only to paws and toes, preventing toe roots from being diluted over the entire lower leg.
propertyDescriptors.name: AutoMapCommonFurGroups

propertyDescriptors.label: Tail region vertex group(s)
propertyDescriptors.description: Optional explicit vertex-group mask for the tail region. It takes priority over automatic classification where its weight is significant.
propertyDescriptors.name: TailRegionGroupName

propertyDescriptors.label: Leg region vertex group(s)
propertyDescriptors.description: Optional explicit vertex-group mask for the legs.
propertyDescriptors.name: LegRegionGroupName

propertyDescriptors.label: Paw region vertex group(s)
propertyDescriptors.description: Optional explicit mask for paws, feet, toes, and claws. This mask controls paw classification, density, reserved roots, and—when regional coverage extension is enabled—whether fur may be created.
propertyDescriptors.name: PawRegionGroupName

propertyDescriptors.label: Ear region vertex group(s)
propertyDescriptors.description: Optional explicit vertex-group mask for the ears.
propertyDescriptors.name: EarRegionGroupName

propertyDescriptors.label: Head region vertex group(s)
propertyDescriptors.description: Optional explicit mask for the head and muzzle. This is a density and coverage region; use the separate head, nose-bridge, and inner-ear length masks to control strand length.
propertyDescriptors.name: HeadRegionGroupName

propertyDescriptors.label: Top/back coverage vertex group(s)
propertyDescriptors.description: Optional explicit coverage mask for the upper back, shoulders, neck top, and back of the head. Multiple names may be separated with commas.
propertyDescriptors.name: TopBackGroupName

propertyDescriptors.label: Automatically fill top/back coverage gaps
propertyDescriptors.description: Creates a dorsal coverage mask from world-up height and surface orientation, but only near existing fur coverage. This fills bare strips on the upper body and back of the head.
propertyDescriptors.name: AutoTopBackCoverage

propertyDescriptors.label: Top/back height start
propertyDescriptors.description: Normalized world-up height where automatic dorsal coverage begins. Lower values cover farther down the sides.
propertyDescriptors.name: TopBackHeightStart

propertyDescriptors.label: Back-head vertical-surface coverage
propertyDescriptors.description: Minimum automatic weight for high vertices whose normals face sideways, such as the vertical rear of the head and neck.
propertyDescriptors.name: TopBackHighVertexBias

propertyDescriptors.label: Top/back coverage expansion rings
propertyDescriptors.description: Connected edge rings used to search from existing fur coverage toward the upper back and back of the head.
propertyDescriptors.name: TopBackCoverageExpansionRings

propertyDescriptors.label: Top/back coverage expansion falloff
propertyDescriptors.description: Weight retained through each top/back coverage expansion ring.
propertyDescriptors.name: TopBackCoverageExpansionFalloff

propertyDescriptors.label: Top/back density multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Increases root selection density on the upper back and rear-head coverage mask without changing hair length.
propertyDescriptors.name: TopBackDensityMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Minimum top/back root share
propertyDescriptors.description: Reserves this fraction of the total root budget for upper-back and back-head candidates before the normal global fill.
propertyDescriptors.name: MinimumTopBackRootShare

propertyDescriptors.label: Top/back root-pool threshold
propertyDescriptors.description: Minimum average top/back mask weight required for a triangle to join the reserved dorsal root pool.
propertyDescriptors.name: TopBackPoolThreshold

propertyDescriptors.label: Automatically detect the back of the head
propertyDescriptors.description: Builds a rear-head mask from the HEAD group in the direction of the BODY group. No separate back-head vertex group is required.
propertyDescriptors.name: AutoBackHeadCoverage

propertyDescriptors.label: Back-head region start
propertyDescriptors.description: Normalized position within the HEAD group where the rear-head mask begins. Lower values include more of the head.
propertyDescriptors.name: BackHeadStart

propertyDescriptors.label: Back-head expansion rings
propertyDescriptors.description: Connected edge rings added around the detected rear-head mask.
propertyDescriptors.name: BackHeadExpansionRings

propertyDescriptors.label: Back-head expansion falloff
propertyDescriptors.description: Weight retained through each rear-head expansion ring.
propertyDescriptors.name: BackHeadExpansionFalloff

propertyDescriptors.label: Back-head density multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Increases root density on the detected rear-facing head surface.
propertyDescriptors.name: BackHeadDensityMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Minimum back-head root share
propertyDescriptors.description: Reserves this fraction of the root budget specifically for the back of the head before the other regional and global fills.
propertyDescriptors.name: MinimumBackHeadRootShare

propertyDescriptors.label: Back-head root-pool threshold
propertyDescriptors.description: Minimum rear-head mask weight required for reserved root selection.
propertyDescriptors.name: BackHeadPoolThreshold

propertyDescriptors.label: Long-coat vertex group(s)
propertyDescriptors.description: Optional mask for especially long, dense, hanging, and wavy coat, such as ears, chest, leg furnishings, belly, and tail.
propertyDescriptors.name: LongCoatGroupName

propertyDescriptors.label: Head hair length vertex group(s)
propertyDescriptors.description: Optional vertex-group mask for head hair length. Multiple names may be separated by commas, semicolons, or |. The interpolated vertex weight blends smoothly between the normal length and the head multiplier.
propertyDescriptors.name: HeadHairLengthGroupName

propertyDescriptors.label: Head hair length multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Outer-coat length at full weight in the head length mask. Values below 1 shorten the coat; values above 1 lengthen it.
propertyDescriptors.name: HeadHairLengthMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Nose bridge hair length vertex group(s)
propertyDescriptors.description: Optional vertex-group mask for the bridge of the nose. This specific mask overrides the broad head mask in overlapping areas.
propertyDescriptors.name: NoseBridgeHairLengthGroupName

propertyDescriptors.label: Nose bridge hair length multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Outer-coat length at full weight on the nose bridge. A value around 0.35–0.60 keeps the muzzle and nose bridge short.
propertyDescriptors.name: NoseBridgeHairLengthMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Inner-ear hair length vertex group(s)
propertyDescriptors.description: Optional vertex-group mask for the inner surfaces of the ears. This specific mask overrides the broad head mask where they overlap.
propertyDescriptors.name: InnerEarsHairLengthGroupName

propertyDescriptors.label: Inner-ear hair length multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Outer-coat length at full weight inside the ears. Use a value below 1 for shorter inner-ear hair or above 1 for furnishings.
propertyDescriptors.name: InnerEarsHairLengthMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Tail density multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Increases root sampling on the tail without increasing torso density by the same amount.
propertyDescriptors.name: TailDensityMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Leg density multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Increases root sampling on the legs.
propertyDescriptors.name: LegDensityMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Paw density multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Increases root sampling on paws and toes.
propertyDescriptors.name: PawDensityMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Ear density multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Increases root sampling on the ears.
propertyDescriptors.name: EarDensityMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Head density multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Increases root sampling on triangles classified as the head region.
propertyDescriptors.name: HeadDensityMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Minimum tail root share
propertyDescriptors.description: Reserves this fraction of all generated roots for the tail when a tail region is available.
propertyDescriptors.name: MinimumTailRootShare

propertyDescriptors.label: Minimum leg root share
propertyDescriptors.description: Reserves this fraction of all generated roots for the legs when a leg region is available.
propertyDescriptors.name: MinimumLegRootShare

propertyDescriptors.label: Minimum paw root share
propertyDescriptors.description: Reserves this fraction of all generated roots for paws when a paw region is available.
propertyDescriptors.name: MinimumPawRootShare

propertyDescriptors.label: Minimum ear root share
propertyDescriptors.description: Reserves this fraction of all generated roots for ears when an ear region is available.
propertyDescriptors.name: MinimumEarRootShare

propertyDescriptors.label: Minimum head root share
propertyDescriptors.description: Reserves this fraction of all generated roots for the head when a head region is available.
propertyDescriptors.name: MinimumHeadRootShare

propertyDescriptors.label: Tail fur length multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Multiplies outer-coat length on the detected tail region.
propertyDescriptors.name: TailLengthMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Tail gravity hanging multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Additional gravity-sag multiplier applied only to roots classified as tail fur. The displacement is evaluated after skeletal skinning, so animated tail bones cannot rotate world-down sideways.
propertyDescriptors.name: TailGravityHangingMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Body gravity hanging multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Gravity-hanging multiplier for ordinary body-region outer coat. The default is 0 so normal body fur continues to cover the model surface. Long-coat masks may still enable hanging locally.
propertyDescriptors.name: BodyGravityHangingMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Leg fur length multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Multiplies outer-coat length on the detected leg region.
propertyDescriptors.name: LegLengthMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Paw fur length multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Multiplies outer-coat length on paws and toes.
propertyDescriptors.name: PawLengthMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Ear fur length multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Multiplies outer-coat length on the detected ear region.
propertyDescriptors.name: EarLengthMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Long-coat density multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Density multiplier at full weight in the long-coat mask.
propertyDescriptors.name: LongCoatDensityMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Long-coat length multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Outer-coat length multiplier at full weight in the long-coat mask.
propertyDescriptors.name: LongCoatLengthMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Long-coat hanging multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Increases downward hanging at full weight in the long-coat mask.
propertyDescriptors.name: LongCoatHangMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Long-coat wave multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Increases traveling-wave motion at full weight in the long-coat mask.
propertyDescriptors.name: LongCoatWaveMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Fallback fur color (R;G;B)
propertyDescriptors.description: Used when the model texture cannot be sampled or when model-texture color strength is below 1.
propertyDescriptors.name: FurColor

propertyDescriptors.label: Use model texture color
propertyDescriptors.description: Samples the model's base-color texture at each generated hair root.
propertyDescriptors.name: UseModelTextureColor

propertyDescriptors.label: Model texture color strength
propertyDescriptors.description: 1 uses the sampled model texture color. 0 uses only the fallback fur color.
propertyDescriptors.name: ModelTextureColorStrength

propertyDescriptors.label: Outer-coat length randomness
propertyDescriptors.description: Random length variation applied to outer-coat strands.
propertyDescriptors.name: LengthRandomness

propertyDescriptors.label: Enable undercoat
propertyDescriptors.description: Creates a separate short and dense undercoat layer.
propertyDescriptors.name: UndercoatEnabled

propertyDescriptors.label: Undercoat strands per root
propertyDescriptors.description: Number of short undercoat strands generated at each distribution root.
propertyDescriptors.name: UndercoatStrandsPerRoot

propertyDescriptors.label: Undercoat length
propertyDescriptors.description: Base length of the short undercoat.
propertyDescriptors.name: UndercoatLength

propertyDescriptors.label: Undercoat thickness
propertyDescriptors.description: Base width of undercoat ribbons. Slightly wider strands hide the model surface more effectively.
propertyDescriptors.name: UndercoatThickness

propertyDescriptors.label: Undercoat bend segments
propertyDescriptors.description: Number of segments in each undercoat strand.
propertyDescriptors.name: UndercoatBendSegments

propertyDescriptors.label: Undercoat root stiffness
propertyDescriptors.description: Higher values keep the short undercoat stable close to the skin.
propertyDescriptors.name: UndercoatRootStiffness

propertyDescriptors.label: Undercoat root spread
propertyDescriptors.description: Spreads undercoat strands around each root to fill gaps.
propertyDescriptors.name: UndercoatRootSpread

propertyDescriptors.label: Undercoat length randomness
propertyDescriptors.description: Random undercoat length variation. A value of 0.18 produces approximately 18% variation.
propertyDescriptors.name: UndercoatLengthRandomness

propertyDescriptors.label: Undercoat darkening
propertyDescriptors.description: Darkens the undercoat relative to the sampled model texture color.
propertyDescriptors.name: UndercoatDarkening

propertyDescriptors.label: Color variation
propertyDescriptors.description: Adds a small random brightness variation between visual strands.
propertyDescriptors.name: ColorVariation

propertyDescriptors.label: Wind direction X
propertyDescriptors.description: World-space X component of the wind direction.
propertyDescriptors.name: WindDirectionX

propertyDescriptors.label: Wind direction Y
propertyDescriptors.description: World-space Y component of the wind direction.
propertyDescriptors.name: WindDirectionY

propertyDescriptors.label: Wind direction Z
propertyDescriptors.description: World-space Z component of the wind direction.
propertyDescriptors.name: WindDirectionZ

propertyDescriptors.label: Wind strength
propertyDescriptors.description: Controls how strongly wind bends the fur.
propertyDescriptors.name: WindStrength

propertyDescriptors.label: Wind frequency
propertyDescriptors.description: Controls the speed of wind flutter.
propertyDescriptors.name: WindFrequency

propertyDescriptors.label: Movement influence
propertyDescriptors.description: Bends the strand shape opposite the object's movement direction. Hair roots remain fixed to the model's skin weights.
propertyDescriptors.name: MovementInfluence

propertyDescriptors.label: Vertical movement influence
propertyDescriptors.description: Controls how much jumping and falling contribute to movement bending. Use 0 to keep landing motion conservative.
propertyDescriptors.name: VerticalMovementInfluence

propertyDescriptors.label: Enable stable tail jump and fall inertia
propertyDescriptors.description: Makes only tail fur react to vertical object movement. Upward jumps bend tail coat downward and falling bends it upward. Every root uses one fixed skinned direction, preventing rapid left/right direction changes.
propertyDescriptors.name: TailVerticalInertiaEnabled

propertyDescriptors.label: Tail vertical inertia influence
propertyDescriptors.description: Strength of the tail-only jump and fall displacement.
propertyDescriptors.name: TailVerticalInertiaInfluence

propertyDescriptors.label: Full tail response vertical speed
propertyDescriptors.description: Vertical object speed that produces the maximum tail response. Lower values make small jumps affect the tail more strongly.
propertyDescriptors.name: TailVerticalFullSpeed

propertyDescriptors.label: Tail vertical velocity smoothing
propertyDescriptors.description: Low-pass filtering time in seconds for the measured vertical speed. Increase this only when the object's Z position is noisy.
propertyDescriptors.name: TailVerticalVelocitySmoothing

propertyDescriptors.label: Tail vertical response smoothing
propertyDescriptors.description: Time in seconds used to blend the tail from its current response toward the new jump, fall, or resting state.
propertyDescriptors.name: TailVerticalResponseSmoothing

propertyDescriptors.label: Tail vertical movement dead zone
propertyDescriptors.description: Ignores very small vertical speeds so idle position jitter cannot move the tail coat.
propertyDescriptors.name: TailVerticalDeadZone

propertyDescriptors.label: Tail jump/fall direction hysteresis
propertyDescriptors.description: Additional speed required before switching directly between jump and fall directions. This prevents rapid sign changes around zero.
propertyDescriptors.name: TailVerticalSignHysteresis

propertyDescriptors.label: Tail vertical inertia tip emphasis
propertyDescriptors.description: Controls how the effect grows from the fixed root toward the tip. Higher values keep more of the strand base stable.
propertyDescriptors.name: TailVerticalInertiaTipPower

propertyDescriptors.label: Fall response that fully reverses tail hanging
propertyDescriptors.description: Normalized fall response at which the static downward tail hanging is completely replaced by upward fall lift. Lower values make the tail reverse earlier during a fall.
propertyDescriptors.name: TailFallOverrideResponse

propertyDescriptors.label: Tail resting gravity alignment
propertyDescriptors.description: Blends tail resting hang from a surface-safe direction toward true world gravity. Use 1 for hair that hangs vertically downward when the tail points down.
propertyDescriptors.name: TailRestGravityAlignment

propertyDescriptors.label: Tail resting hang multiplier
propertyDescriptors.description: Strength multiplier for the normal resting tail hang. Fall lift still replaces the downward hang.
propertyDescriptors.name: TailRestHangMultiplier

propertyDescriptors.label: Full movement speed
propertyDescriptors.description: Object speed that produces the maximum movement-bending amount.
propertyDescriptors.name: MovementVelocityScale

propertyDescriptors.label: Gravity bend
propertyDescriptors.description: Additional global gravity bending applied to every fur region. Keep this at 0 for normal short body coat; use regional hanging and long-coat masks for controlled downward fur.
propertyDescriptors.name: GravityStrength

propertyDescriptors.label: Long-fur hanging strength
propertyDescriptors.description: Global scale for regional and long-coat hanging. Ordinary body fur is unaffected while Body gravity hanging multiplier is 0.
propertyDescriptors.name: HangStrength

propertyDescriptors.label: Hanging start along strand
propertyDescriptors.description: Fraction near the root that remains rigid before downward hanging begins.
propertyDescriptors.name: HangStart

propertyDescriptors.label: Long-coat wave amplitude
propertyDescriptors.description: Amplitude of the traveling side-to-side wave along outer-coat strands.
propertyDescriptors.name: WaveAmplitude

propertyDescriptors.label: Waves along strand
propertyDescriptors.description: Number of wave cycles from root to tip.
propertyDescriptors.name: WaveAlongHair

propertyDescriptors.label: Long-coat wave speed
propertyDescriptors.description: Speed at which the wave travels along the strand.
propertyDescriptors.name: WaveSpeed

propertyDescriptors.label: Resting wave amount
propertyDescriptors.description: Small wave amount applied while the object is stationary.
propertyDescriptors.name: RestWaveAmount

propertyDescriptors.label: Movement wave boost
propertyDescriptors.description: Controls how strongly movement speed increases long-coat waves.
propertyDescriptors.name: MovementWaveBoost

propertyDescriptors.label: Motion updates per second
propertyDescriptors.description: Updates only shader uniforms such as motion, wind, and time. Static fur geometry is not rewritten every frame.
propertyDescriptors.name: UpdateRate

propertyDescriptors.label: Maximum visual strands
propertyDescriptors.description: Upper limit for the combined number of outer-coat and undercoat strands.
propertyDescriptors.name: MaximumVisualStrands

propertyDescriptors.label: Maximum fur memory (MB)
propertyDescriptors.description: Approximate geometry-memory budget. The extension automatically reduces the root count when the estimated budget is exceeded.
propertyDescriptors.name: MaximumFurMemoryMB

propertyDescriptors.label: Maximum camera distance
propertyDescriptors.description: Hides the fur beyond this camera distance. Set to 0 to disable distance culling.
propertyDescriptors.name: MaximumDistance

propertyDescriptors.label: Cast shadows
propertyDescriptors.description: Lets fur cast shadows. This can be expensive with a high strand count.
propertyDescriptors.name: CastShadow

propertyDescriptors.label: Random seed
propertyDescriptors.description: Using the same value produces the same root and strand distribution.
propertyDescriptors.name: Seed

propertyDescriptors.label: Debug logging
propertyDescriptors.description: Writes build and runtime status messages to the preview console.
propertyDescriptors.name: DebugLog

propertyDescriptors.label: Tail bone keywords
propertyDescriptors.description: Comma-separated substrings used to recognize tail bones automatically.
propertyDescriptors.name: TailBoneKeywords

propertyDescriptors.label: Leg bone keywords
propertyDescriptors.description: Comma-separated substrings used to recognize front- and hind-leg bones automatically.
propertyDescriptors.name: LegBoneKeywords

propertyDescriptors.label: Paw bone keywords
propertyDescriptors.description: Comma-separated substrings used to recognize paw, foot, toe, and digit bones automatically.
propertyDescriptors.name: PawBoneKeywords

propertyDescriptors.label: Ear bone keywords
propertyDescriptors.description: Comma-separated substrings used to recognize ear bones automatically.
propertyDescriptors.name: EarBoneKeywords

propertyDescriptors.label: Head bone keywords
propertyDescriptors.description: Comma-separated substrings used to identify head and muzzle bones for automatic regional coverage and density.
propertyDescriptors.name: HeadBoneKeywords
